annotations.title: Before and after a proposed change

description:
Any change to one portfolio, measured before it is made: the current and the proposed
        holdings side by side on the same price history (structure, risk, worst falls,
        and what the change adds or removes). For a single new holding,
        check_before_you_buy says more; for one holding at every weight,
        sweep_holding. current and proposed are the two sets of holdings; start and
        end, when given, fix the window instead of the longest shared one. The 'after'
        figures are counterfactual. Never says whether to make the change.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

proposed.description: What would be held after the change, {ticker: weight}.
proposed.title: Proposed

name: test_a_change

outputSchema.description: The current and the proposed portfolio on the same history. The 'after' figures are counterfactual: that portfolio was not held.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

axes.description: Per axis: label, the question it answers, before, after.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

deltas.description: Per measure: label, before, after, direction, unit.

historical.description: Per past crisis: before and after.

introduces.description: Risk the proposed holdings add that the current ones did not carry.

summary.description: One sentence on what the change moves.

window.description: The shared window: start, end, years, which holding set it, crises inside.

worsened.description: Measures that moved the other way.
